## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what changes. Link an issue for large features or architectural changes.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. For native UI changes, attach before/after screenshots from a real run. For inference/research changes, record the model revision, settings and measured baseline/control result.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe effects on saved studies, SDK/API clients, serving latency/memory, ports/network access, and release packaging. Include migration or rollback steps when applicable.

- [ ] The change is focused; unrelated formatting/refactoring is separate.
- [ ] Relevant tests and docs are updated; limitations are stated honestly.
- [ ] No private prompts, model weights, credentials or personal IPs are included.
- [ ] Dependencies and workflow/permission changes are explained.
- [ ] Research UI does not present probabilities, norms or probes as proof of safety.
